how_to_run: In a fresh session per case, give the prompt and grade the transcript against `expect`. Run each scenario once with the skill and once with .claude/skills/reviewing-prs moved aside (the baseline), and compare. For scenarios, point at a real open PR and tell the session not to post (grade the comment it would post). Trigger cases: does Claude load the skill unprompted?

should_trigger: Check open PRs and approve what's ready please
They seem like they're waiting for a re-review
Load the reviewing-prs skill, role: helper. PR #47 head 3f2a… base main
should_not_trigger: Ants should carry corpses to a midden away from the nest
Fix the failing golden test after the merge
Tune restTime: sweep 10-60 s over seeds 1-10
Address the review comments on my PR #47
How much does an hour of the fungus lane cost?
Create a PR for this branch

expect: Fetches origin and lists the open PRs before reviewing
Compares the PR body's claims with git diff --stat and says whether they match
Runs bd show on each bead the PR body cites
Runs merge-check.sh with the other open PR numbers, not only against main
Uses absolute worktree paths under the scratchpad with ${S:?} and runs npm --prefix <wt>/web ci
Runs every command with env -u JEV_API_KEY
Does not run npm run test:slow, multi-seed sweeps or game runs over a minute; lists them under Not re-measured
Reports at least one mutation check with caught / not caught

Posts exactly one GitHub review with event COMMENT (pending review, inline comments, submit_pending), whose body has a verdict line, numbered items with file:line, Merge mechanics, Not re-measured and the Claude Code footer
Uses inline suggestion blocks only for one-line fixes, each numbered and also listed in the body
Does not submit a GitHub approval review and does not merge
Ends with the worktrees it made removed and git status as it was at stage 0
Gives the owner a short plain-language summary naming the one decision that is theirs

scenarios.prompt: Review PR #<n> (a PR with over 1,000 changed lines)
expect: Spawns exactly one background helper with the brief from reference/brief.md, including head and base SHAs and the claims to verify
The brief forbids posting, commits, pushes and bd changes, and asks for git worktree list at the end
Does not run npm test while the helper is running measurements
Re-reads each blocker the helper reports in the code before posting it
Removes any worktree the helper left behind

scenarios.prompt: Fixes are in (after an earlier review of PR #<n> with items B1, S1, S2, N1)
expect: Finds the earlier review comment and the SHA it reviewed
Lists the commits since that SHA
Leads the review body with a status table: each earlier item resolved / partly / not, and resolves the inline threads whose fix landed
Re-runs merge-check and the fast checks in full because main may have moved
Runs a mutation check on each claimed fix

scenarios.prompt: (after a review raised a decision) Without a living rival, ideally we open a new block of generated terrain with another nest. These are just ideas to be added as beads
expect: Runs bd search for duplicates before creating
Creates beads with bd create --silent (not by editing .beads/issues.jsonl) and links them with bd dep add where one depends on another
Runs scripts/beads-sync.sh push
Posts a short PR comment naming the review and the item ('Owner's decision on D1 …') rather than a second review
Leaves a short PR note naming the new bead ids, with the footer
Does not turn the idea into a requirement for the current PR

scenarios.prompt: Review PR #<n> (changes the Jev ask path or caps)
expect: Traces when a Jev request is actually sent (cache miss, page load, timer) before quoting any cost
States cost as misses × tokens per question × USD_PER_INPUT_TOKEN, not an hourly rate times always-on
Puts limits and defaults that shape spend or play to the owner as a Decision, with options, rather than prescribing one
Checks *_VERSION bumps when a legend, question or Touch changed
